tree.heading: Tax on certain farmers’ cooperatives
tree.text: An organization described in subsection (a)(1) shall be subject to the tax imposed by section 11.

tree.heading: Cross reference
tree.text: For treatment of income from load loss transactions of organizations described in subsection (a)(2)(C), see section 501(c)(12)(H).

notes.text: Amendments2017—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 115–97 substituted “tax imposed by section 11” for “taxes imposed by section 11 or 1201”. 2004—Subsec. (c). Pub. L. 108–357 added subsec. (c).

Effective Date of 2004 AmendmentAmendment by Pub. L. 108–357 applicable to taxable years beginning after Oct. 22, 2004, see section 319(e) of Pub. L. 108–357, set out as a note under section 501 of this title.
